notes: STATUS: draft. sync/v1 stays draft until the iOS app has passed these vectors; the server producing and checking them is not independent validation.

The steps are ONE timeline against ONE server, in order. Replay, expiry, revocation and cursors depend on what came before. Run them in order against your client's request builder and response parser; each step is self-contained (full request, full response), so a mock server can serve the recorded responses.
server_clock_unix is the server's clock for that step. Build ts from the step's `signing.ts`, not from your own clock. A step whose signing.ts differs from server_clock_unix is a skew case.

For a signed step, rebuild signing.signing_string from request (method, request_target, signing.ts, signing.nonce, SHA-256 of the body, signing.client_id) and require it equal. matches_request=false marks a step where the request sent differs from what was signed: your string for the request AS SENT will not equal signing_string, which is the point.

signature_der_base64 is ASN.1 DER ECDSA-P256-SHA256, standard base64. These signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979) so the file is reproducible; CryptoKit's are randomised, so verify rather than compare. signature_valid says whether it verifies over signing_string under the registered key of the client the header names.
The test keys are public and protect nothing. Client keys are in fixture.clients; the dongle's device key and the receipt-signing key are given as Ed25519 public keys.

response.body_json is the compacted JSON the server sent; compare it as JSON, not as text. response.body_hex is used for non-JSON bodies (CBOR receipts). Opaque values (bearer token, cursor, epoch) are whatever this server drew: a client must treat them as opaque; they appear verbatim because later steps use them.

Every authentication failure is 401 with error `unauthenticated` and the message `authentication failed`, whatever was wrong (the one exception is a bearer token on a signed-only route: `signature_required`). Do not branch on the cause.
Not covered here: the 200 Parquet body of /v1/snapshot (it is the analytical store's output, not the sync protocol's) and the administration listings.

steps.name: health
steps.doc: Unauthenticated liveness. instance_id is what the app compares between its LAN and Tailnet URLs; server_time is for diagnosing clock skew.

steps.name: enrol_admin
steps.doc: A valid enrolment: 201 with the client id, role, scope and the server identity to pin.

steps.name: enrol_alpha
steps.doc: A client scoped to one vehicle (v1).

steps.name: enrol_bad_proof
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the proof was made by a different key than the one being enrolled. 400, and the invitation is NOT consumed.

steps.name: enrol_bravo_after_bad_proof
steps.doc: The same invitation still works after the bad proof above.

steps.name: enrol_charlie
steps.doc: A second client scoped to v1; used for the revocation steps.

steps.name: enrol_code_already_used
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: an invitation works once. 403 enrolment_refused (a used, expired or unknown code all look the same).

steps.name: token_mint_alpha
steps.doc: Mint a 1-hour bearer token (signed, empty body). The token is opaque: its value here is whatever this server drew, a client must not parse it.

steps.name: token_mint_charlie
steps.doc: A token for the client that is revoked later.

steps.name: token_on_signed_only_route
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a bearer token on /v1/auth/token, which accepts signatures only. 401 signature_required: the one 401 that is not the uniform `unauthenticated`, because the client knows it sent a token.

steps.name: push_accepted
steps.doc: A signed push of one append-only operation: accepted with its server_sequence.

steps.name: push_duplicate
steps.doc: The same operation again (a retry, with a NEW nonce and signature): `duplicate` carrying the original server_sequence. This is success; creates nothing.

steps.name: push_with_bearer_token
steps.doc: Push authenticated by the bearer token instead of a signature.

steps.name: push_rejected_scope
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, wrong scope: alpha is scoped to v1 and names v2. 200 overall, the operation is `rejected` with reason `scope`.

steps.name: push_rejected_unknown_vehicle
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, unknown vehicle: a client scoped to every vehicle names one that does not exist. `rejected`, reason `unknown_vehicle`.

steps.name: push_rejected_archived_vehicle
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the vehicle is archived. `rejected`, reason `archived_vehicle`.

steps.name: push_rejected_hash_mismatch
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: content_hash is not the SHA-256 of the canonical payload. `rejected`, reason `hash_mismatch`.

steps.name: push_rejected_operation_id_conflict
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: an operation_id reused with different content. `rejected`, reason `operation_id_conflict`.

steps.name: push_rejected_client_mismatch
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the operation names a different client_id than the one authenticated. `rejected`, reason `client_mismatch`.

steps.name: push_mutable_accepted
steps.doc: A mutable kind: per-field revisions come back (`title` is now at revision 1).

steps.name: push_mutable_conflict
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: base_revision says `title` was last seen at 0 but the server holds revision 1. `conflict` with the current value; nothing is applied.

steps.name: push_malformed_body
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: not JSON. 400 bad_request.

steps.name: push_no_operations
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a push carries 1 to 200 operations. 400 bad_request.

steps.name: pull_first_page
steps.doc: First page, no cursor, limit 3. Changes are in server_sequence order and scoped to the client's vehicle (v1 only). has_more is true.

steps.name: pull_second_page
steps.doc: The page after the first cursor.

steps.name: pull_second_page_again
steps.doc: A cursor is repeatable: the same request with a new nonce returns the byte-identical page.

steps.name: pull_last_page
steps.doc: Follow the cursor to the end with the default limit: has_more is false.

steps.name: pull_scoped_to_other_vehicle
steps.doc: VEHICLE SCOPING: bravo is scoped to v2 and sees only v2's records, none of alpha's operations.

steps.name: pull_all_vehicles
steps.doc: A client scoped to every vehicle sees all of them (including the archived one, flagged `archived`).

steps.name: pull_with_bearer_token
steps.doc: Pull authenticated by a bearer token.

steps.name: pull_bad_cursor
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a cursor the server did not issue. 400 bad_cursor.

steps.name: pull_cursor_from_another_epoch
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a well-formed cursor from a different epoch (the server's data was reset). 410 cursor_reset: discard server-derived data and resync, do NOT treat as up to date.

body_json.message: the server's data was reset; resync from scratch

steps.name: pull_bad_limit
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: limit must be a positive integer. 400 bad_request.

body_json.message: limit must be a positive integer

steps.name: ack_accepted
steps.doc: Acknowledge the cursor durably applied; the server reports the sequence it now holds.

steps.name: ack_bad_cursor
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: an ack of a cursor the server cannot place. 400 bad_cursor.

body_json.message: cursor is not valid for this server

steps.name: ack_unknown_field
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: unknown fields are refused. 400 bad_request.

steps.name: snapshot_scoped_client_must_name_a_vehicle
steps.doc: VEHICLE SCOPING: a client scoped to specific vehicles must name one. 403 vehicle_required.

body_json.message: this client is scoped to specific vehicles; name one with ?vehicle=<id>

steps.name: snapshot_other_vehicle
steps.doc: VEHICLE SCOPING, wrong scope: alpha asks for v2. 403 scope.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: snapshot_unknown_vehicle
steps.doc: VEHICLE SCOPING, unknown vehicle: the same 403 scope as a real car outside the scope, so the endpoint cannot be used to probe for cars.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: snapshot_malformed_vehicle
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: vehicle is not 32 lowercase hex. 400 bad_request.

steps.name: admin_route_as_user
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: authenticated but not an admin. 403 admin_required.

steps.name: relay_offer_out_of_scope
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, wrong scope: bravo (v2) offers a bundle whose manifest names v1. 403 scope, before any state is written.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: relay_chunk_after_refused_offer
steps.doc: The refused offer left nothing behind: there is no offer to upload against. 404 unknown_bundle.

body_json.message: no offer on record for this bundle; offer it first

steps.name: relay_offer_without_signature_header
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: X-Cairn-Signature is required (128 hex). 400 bad_request.

steps.name: relay_offer_bad_manifest_signature
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the manifest's device signature does not verify (one bit flipped). 401 bad_manifest_signature. Distinct from a bad REQUEST signature: this authenticates the data, not the caller.

steps.name: relay_offer
steps.doc: OFFER: the manifest verbatim, its device signature in X-Cairn-Signature. The answer lists every missing chunk with its offset and length in the bundle byte stream and its SHA-256, so the phone needs no CBOR parser.

steps.name: relay_receipt_before_commit
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: no receipt exists yet. 404 no_receipt.

body_json.message: this bundle has no receipt yet

steps.name: relay_commit_with_chunks_missing
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: commit before every chunk is uploaded. 409 chunks_missing.

steps.name: relay_chunk_wrong_bytes
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the bytes do not hash to the digest in the URL. 409 chunk_mismatch.

body_json.message: data does not match its declared digest

steps.name: relay_chunk_0
steps.doc: CHUNK: PUT the exact range the offer named; 200 when the bytes hash to the URL digest and match the manifest's descriptor. Chunks are idempotent.

steps.name: relay_chunk_1
steps.doc: CHUNK: PUT the exact range the offer named; 200 when the bytes hash to the URL digest and match the manifest's descriptor. Chunks are idempotent.

steps.name: relay_chunk_2_bearer
steps.doc: CHUNK: the last chunk is uploaded with the bearer token, as a background URLSession would. 200 when the bytes hash to the URL digest and match the manifest's descriptor.

steps.name: relay_chunk_out_of_scope
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, wrong scope: bravo learned the bundle id and tries to upload to it. 403 scope: scope is checked on every step, not only the offer.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: relay_commit_out_of_scope
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, wrong scope: bravo cannot commit it either. 403 scope.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: relay_commit
steps.doc: COMMIT (empty body): the signed receipt, CBOR, taken verbatim; its signature covers exactly those bytes. Verify with fixture.receipt_signing_public_key_ed25519_hex; it names this bundle's content root.

steps.name: relay_commit_again
steps.doc: Committing again returns the same receipt bytes, flagged X-Cairn-Already-Committed.

steps.name: relay_receipt
steps.doc: RECEIPT: fetched on its own, byte-identical to the commit's.

steps.name: relay_receipt_out_of_scope
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, wrong scope: bravo cannot read it. 403 scope.

body_json.message: that vehicle is outside this client's scope

steps.name: relay_reoffer_after_commit
steps.doc: Offering a delivered bundle again asks for nothing and says a receipt exists.

steps.name: auth_baseline
steps.doc: A correctly signed request. Every authentication negative below is this request with one thing wrong.

steps.name: auth_replay_same_header
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, replay: the identical Authorization header again. A nonce is accepted once per client. 401 unauthenticated. Never retry with the same header.

signing.mutation: replay: the Authorization header of auth_baseline, byte for byte

steps.name: auth_bad_signature
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, bad signature: one bit of the DER signature flipped. 401 unauthenticated, the same body as every other authentication failure.

signing.mutation: last byte of the DER signature XOR 0x01

steps.name: auth_signed_with_another_key
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: signed correctly, but by bravo's key while claiming to be alpha. 401.

steps.name: auth_target_changed_after_signing
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the request target sent (limit=2) is not the one signed (limit=1). 401: the target is covered byte for byte.

steps.name: auth_body_changed_after_signing
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: the body sent is not the one whose hash was signed. 401.

steps.name: auth_unknown_client
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, unknown client: well-formed and signed, but the client id is not enrolled. 401, indistinguishable from a bad signature.

steps.name: auth_skew_120s_behind_is_accepted
steps.doc: The window is +/-120 s: a timestamp exactly 120 s behind the server is accepted.

steps.name: auth_skew_120s_ahead_is_accepted
steps.doc: A timestamp exactly 120 s ahead is accepted.

steps.name: auth_skew_121s_behind
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, clock skew: 121 s behind. 401. (GET /v1/health returns server_time for diagnosing this.)

steps.name: auth_skew_121s_ahead
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, clock skew: 121 s ahead. 401.

steps.name: auth_nonce_too_short
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: nonce is 16 to 64 characters; this one has 8. 401.

steps.name: auth_missing_header
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header. 401, with `WWW-Authenticate: Cairn-Sig`.

steps.name: auth_unknown_scheme
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: an Authorization scheme the server does not speak. 401.

steps.name: auth_header_missing_signature
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a Cairn-Sig header with no sig parameter. 401.

steps.name: auth_unknown_bearer_token
steps.doc: NEGATIVE: a bearer token the server never issued. 401.

steps.name: revoke_charlie_works_before
steps.doc: Before revocation charlie's signed request is accepted.

steps.name: revoke_charlie_token_works_before
steps.doc: ...and so is charlie's bearer token.

steps.name: revoke_charlie
steps.doc: An admin revokes charlie; effective on charlie's next request.

steps.name: revoked_client_signed_request
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, revoked: a correctly signed request from a revoked client. 401, the same uniform body.

steps.name: revoked_client_bearer_token
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, revoked: the bearer token minted before the revocation stops working with the client (re-checked on every use). 401.

steps.name: token_valid_at_exactly_one_hour
steps.doc: A token minted at server clock T is still accepted at T+3600 s.

steps.name: token_expired
steps.doc: NEGATIVE, expired token: one second later it is not. 401. Mint a new one (signed) and retry.

steps.name: token_mint_after_expiry
steps.doc: Minting again, signed, works: expiry costs one request, not the enrolment.
